name: console_status
description: Configured services and qualification. Probe is explicit; payload port is NEVER probed.

name: link_status
description: Per-service connection health (ftp, klog, debug, payload) recorded from actual use, retry/backoff policy and payload rate limit. probe=true runs an explicit reachability check; the payload port is never probed. No background probing occurs.

name: desktop_status
description: Discover IDA/Ghidra versions/paths, native GDB plugin and local GDB dependency without launching applications.

name: debugger_info
description: Read-only NG handshake: protocol, decimal firmware, platform and brand; not a binary hash proof.

name: ftp_list
description: Bounded anonymous FTP LIST. Remote names/content are untrusted data.

name: ftp_download
description: Download a remote file to a hashed local artifact.

name: ftp_extract
description: Extract 1-64 explicit files with a cumulative byte budget and a saved manifest; partial failure is explicit, no retry.

name: ftp_upload
description: Upload ONLY under profile allowlist, then hash-check downloaded readback. May overwrite remote file.

artifact.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

name: klog_capture
description: Capture bounded raw Klog bytes and timestamp envelope. Does not enable Klog or reconnect.

name: payload_inspect
description: Validate local BIN manifest against claimed firmware, actual host/HEN and artifact hash. Never executes.

manifest.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

name: payload_execute
description: Send a hardware-allowlisted BIN once. Execution unacknowledged; NEVER automatically retry.

manifest.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

name: process_list
description: List processes through firmware-checked debugger.

name: process_info
description: Get process identity, title ID and content ID.

name: process_maps
description: Get process memory maps. Offsets are not verified ELF image bases.

name: memory_read
description: Read bounded process memory to a local hashed artifact; non-atomic.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: memory_peek
description: Small live memory read without creating artifact files; useful for native debugger views.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: memory_region_dump
description: Chunk a readable mapped range into a hashed raw dump; preserve partial data and explicit completion status.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: memory_typed
description: Read one little-endian typed process value. 64-bit integers returned as strings.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: memory_snapshot
description: Capture memory plus process/maps/application/hash provenance. Hash is user supplied; not an atomic dump.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: memory_diff
description: Compare two bounded local captures by offset, with capped changed ranges.

before.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

after.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

name: pattern_scan
description: Scan a local bounded capture for hex bytes / ?? wildcards; never triggers server scan extensions.

artifact.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

name: memory_write
description: Compare expected bytes, save backup/replacement, write and readback. Non-atomic; no automatic rollback.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: kernel_read
description: Explicitly opted-in bounded kernel read; kernel access is not kernel breakpoint debugging.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: kernel_base
description: Read kernel base only after explicit kernel-read qualification.

name: kernel_write
description: High-risk kernel write with expected bytes, backup and readback; requires kernel_read too.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: debug_attach
description: Attach to a process; may halt it. Requires explicit local callback interface and inbound TCP 755.

listen_address.description: Local PC IPv4 reachable from console

name: debug_detach
description: Detach/resume and clear backend breakpoints for this session. Available for cleanup.

name: debug_threads
description: List threads of the attached process. Requires a persistent MCP session.

name: debug_registers
description: Read exact pinned-source 176-byte GP register layout (not protocol doc's 184).

name: debug_events
description: Poll up to 16 asynchronous 1184-byte event packets without blocking.

name: debug_control
description: Halt/resume/step or suspend/resume a thread. No process kill or reboot command exposed.

name: debug_breakpoint
description: Set/clear one of 30 software breakpoint slots; changes target instruction bytes. Optional condition (expression on live registers), log template and stop_after hit count are tracked host-side.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

condition.description: Expression evaluated on live registers at each hit; run continues while false

log.description: Log template recorded with each hit (event JSON)

stop_after.description: Stop only after this many hits (0 = every hit)

name: debug_watchpoint
description: Set/clear one of four aligned hardware watchpoint slots.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: annotation_save
description: Save local evidence-backed module/RVA comment or symbol for analysis handoff; does not mutate Ghidra.

artifact.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

rva.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: ghidra_export
description: Create a Ghidra handoff bundle with raw artifact and requested image base. Not reconstructed ELF.

artifact.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

image_base.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: artifact_list
description: List bounded capture metadata; local files may contain sensitive console data.

name: artifact_read
description: Read up to 4096 bytes of a local artifact by offset, as hex and UTF-8 preview.

artifact.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

name: experiment_bundle
description: Archive selected artifacts, metadata and profile; no network export.

items.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

name: sdk_status
description: Discover local toolchain paths/executables without running or installing them.

name: sdk_scaffold
description: Create SDK recipe/reference workspace. Requires a pinned upstream sample before build; no fake offsets or APIs.

name: sdk_build
description: Run a locally hash-allowlisted build recipe with bounded logs/time; never deploy automatically.

recipe.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

name: debug_step
description: Step one instruction (into), over calls (over), or out of the current function (out). Over/out use a temporary internal breakpoint when a single step cannot stop there. Live registers are re-read after every stop.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock bound for waiting on console stop events

name: debug_run
description: Resume all threads and report stop events. Stops at the first event unless condition is given and false (then resumes), when the target address is hit, or when a breakpoint reaches stop_after hits. Bounded by max_stops and timeout_seconds; never resumes after the final stop.

target_address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

condition.description: Expression evaluated on the stopped thread's live registers, e.g. rax == 0x1234 or [rsp] != 0; run continues while it is false

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock bound for waiting on console stop events

name: debug_stack
description: Call-stack unwind for a thread: DWARF .eh_frame CFI first (handles -fomit-frame-pointer code), then the rbp frame-pointer chain, then a bounded stack scan for executable return addresses; each frame reports its method in `via` and is annotated with module+offset.

name: debug_eval
description: Evaluate an expression against live state: registers (rax, rip, ...), module bases (eboot.bin+0x1000), labels and memory reads ([rsp+8], dword [rax]). Bounded memory reads.

name: disassemble
description: Live x86-64 disassembly from a process address; original bytes of our own breakpoints are masked out and branch targets annotated with module+offset.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: module_list
description: Named modules of a process with base, size and per-segment protection, aggregated from the memory maps.

name: debug_registers_set
description: Write GP registers (rip/rflags included, flag bits masked to writable set) with readback verification. Fails closed if the server wrote a different thread.

value.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: debug_registers_fpu
description: Read the FPU/SSE state of a thread: x87 control/status, ST0-7, XMM0-15, YMM high halves, MXCSR.

name: debug_registers_dr
description: Read the hardware debug registers DR0-3/6/7 of a thread.

name: debug_breakpoint_list
description: List tracked breakpoints with condition, log template, stop_after and hit counts. Internal step/run breakpoints are hidden.

name: artifact_info
description: Static structural parse of a local artifact: ELF64 header/program headers/sections/symbols/DT_NEEDED imports, or SCE SELF/PKG identification. No console access.

artifact.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

name: artifact_disasm
description: Static x86-64 disassembly of an artifact range without touching the console; address is the virtual address the offset is mapped at.

artifact.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: artifact_strings
description: Bounded printable-string extraction from a local artifact for reference hunting.

artifact.description: Relative path inside configured artifact directory

name: code_xrefs
description: Find live instructions that reference a target address: call/jmp rel32 and rip-relative operands, decoded locally over executable mappings. No server-side scan.

target_address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

address.description: Optional scan start address to restrict search range

name: memory_search
description: Live pattern search (hex bytes with ?? wildcards) over a bounded readable range; the scan runs locally on chunked reads.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: debug_label
description: Set/remove/list host-side labels used by debug_eval and disassembly annotations (e.g. a function name at an address). Local only; no console mutation.

address.description: Unsigned address or RVA, e.g. 0x400000; string avoids JSON precision loss

name: debug_breakpoint_save
description: Export tracked breakpoints (with condition/log/stop_after/hits) and watchpoints as a versioned JSON document.

name: debug_breakpoint_load
description: Re-apply a document from debug_breakpoint_save; sets/clears console breakpoint and watchpoint slots.

name: debug_watchpoint_list
description: List tracked hardware watchpoints (slot, address, length, access).

name: assemble
description: Host-side x86-64 Intel-syntax assembler with labels, RIP-relative addressing, FS/GS segment prefixes, SSE, and db/dw/dd/dq directives. Purely local; never touches the console.

base_address.description: Target virtual address for relative branches and RIP-relative displacements (default 0x0)

name: memory_patch
description: Assemble x86-64 instructions or decode hex bytes at a live process address, optionally NOP-pad to the overwritten instruction boundary, save a prewrite backup, write, and verify readback.

name: patch_list
description: List all recorded memory patches in this session (id, pid, address, original_hex, patched_hex, active, comment).

name: patch_restore
description: Restore the original bytes of a recorded session patch by id and verify via readback.

name: memory_scan
description: Stateful multi-pass live memory value scanner (first, next, get, list, reset) supporting integers, floats, strings, and byte patterns across readable/writable mappings.

name: memory_alloc
description: Allocate RWX virtual memory in a target process via CMD_PROC_ALLOC (0xBDAA000B) or hinted allocation (0xBDAA000E) for code caves and trampolines.

name: memory_free
description: Free virtual memory in a target process via CMD_PROC_FREE (0xBDAA000C).

name: memory_protect
description: Change page protection (VM_PROT_READ=1, WRITE=2, EXECUTE=4, 0..=7) via CMD_PROC_PROTECT (0xBDAA0008) with maps readback verification.

name: memory_elf_dump
description: Reconstruct an offline-analyzable ELF64 binary from a live decrypted PS4 module (eboot.bin or .sprx) by dumping its in-memory PT_LOAD segments into the artifact store.

module.description: Module name (e.g. eboot.bin or libScePad.sprx); defaults to eboot.bin

base_address.description: Explicit ELF header base address override

name: debug_registers_fpu_set
description: Modify x87/XMM0-15/YMM_HIGH0-15/MXCSR registers via 832-byte savefpu_ymm read-modify-write (0xBDBB000B) with readback verification.

changes.description: Map of register names (xmm0..xmm15, ymm0_high..ymm15_high, st0..st7, mxcsr, fcw, fsw) to hex strings, scalar floats, or {"f32":[...]} / {"f64":[...]}

name: debug_tls
description: Read FSBASE (Orbis pthread TLS) and GSBASE for a thread via CMD_DEBUG_GETTLS (0xBDBB000E).

name: debug_tls_set
description: Write FSBASE and/or GSBASE for a thread via CMD_DEBUG_SETTLS (0xBDBB000F) with readback verification.

name: debug_label_save
description: Save all host-side debugger labels to a contained JSON artifact in the artifact store.

name: debug_label_load
description: Load host-side debugger labels from a saved JSON artifact (replaces existing labels unless merge=true).

name: nid_resolve
description: Compute Orbis OS 11-char SHA-1 NIDs from symbol names and/or demangle NIDs (bare or NID#lib#mod) using the built-in PS4 SDK corpus and optional custom dictionary artifact.

dictionary_artifact.description: Optional relative artifact path to a JSON or line-delimited NID dictionary

name: address_rebase
description: Translate addresses bidirectionally between live ASLR runtime VA, static analyzer VA (0x0, 0x100000, 0x400000, or ELF image_base), and module+offset. A runtime_address is also correlated with its containing process map; addresses outside the module list fall back to a map-offset image-base estimate (basis: process_maps_estimate). Optional module_sha256/application_version are recorded as provenance.

module_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the analyzed module, recorded as provenance
